description: Geological Survey & Mines Bureau - Amendment to the Mines and Minerals Act, No. 33 of 1992
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Environment under the Mines and Minerals Act, No. 33 of 1992, specifically amending the Mining (Licensing) Regulations. It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
